title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
premise: On Christmas Eve, the miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by the ghost of his old partner, Jacob Marley, who warns him that three spirits are coming.

moments.title: Marley’s warning
moments.happened: Marley’s chained ghost warns Scrooge to change, or share his fate.
alternatives: Scrooge goes to Fred’s party that night

moments.title: Belle walks away
moments.happened: The first spirit shows young Scrooge losing his fiancée, Belle, to his love of money.

moments.title: The Cratchits’ dinner
moments.happened: The second spirit shows the Cratchits’ small Christmas dinner, and frail Tiny Tim.
alternatives: Scrooge visits the Cratchits in person

moments.title: The neglected grave
moments.happened: The last spirit shows Scrooge a lonely, untended grave bearing his own name.
alternatives: The grave belongs to someone else

moments.title: Christmas morning
moments.happened: Scrooge wakes a changed man and sends a prize turkey to the Cratchits.
alternatives: Scrooge goes to the Cratchits himself
Scrooge decides it was all a dream
